messages.content: Explain a linked list in simple words.
A linked list is a data structure made of nodes. Each node stores data and a pointer to the next node.
What is a stack in DSA?
A stack follows LIFO: Last In, First Out. Its common operations are push, pop, and top.
Explain binary search and its complexity.
Binary search repeatedly halves a sorted search interval. Its time complexity is O(log n).
Breadth-First Search traverses a graph level by level, typically using a queue.
A hash map stores key-value pairs and usually provides average O(1) lookup, insertion, and deletion.
